name: Computer Shrilow
storyline:
The General Gameplay of Computer Shrilow takes after the classic clicker games, but obviously with its own twists, like minigames and events! and it has a plot, for some reason. aside from the basics of clicking and automating your money gain, theres many other things to do! such as minigames, events, shops, people you can talk to, pet things? and more!

The game may seem complicated at first with all its features, but through the tutorial and the general ease of access to these features, you get the hang of them quite fast! making for a fun gameplay loop that gets more unique as it goes on...

All of this is accompanied by a wonderful OST composed by our wonderful musicians nevermaur, OJSTheCoder, and some guests!
summary: Computer Shrilow is a clicker game dedicated to being actually playable! you can speak to people, gamble, try on new clothes, mine in the mines, and much more! The game also has Minigames and Events, which trigger every once in awhile, keeps you on your toes! or. paws? Theres something more going on than meets the eye however, and the only way to find out? is to play it for yourself!
